jobs.title: Full-Time Campus Security Officer – Youth Center
jobs.description:
Management & Training Corporation (MTC) operates the Joliet Job Corps Center in Joliet, IL, seeking staff for campus security and related duties. The role covers controlling access, patrolling grounds, and ensuring safety for students and staff, in line with government and organizational directives.

Responsibilities include responding to emergencies, issuing visitor badges, maintaining incident logs, and supporting center operations while promoting zero-tolerance safety policies.
